description: This file contains a series of unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler, focusing on task execution order, continuation, concurrency, and scheduling behavior within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests_Set2
classes.description: A comprehensive test suite for Orleans task scheduler, covering various scheduling scenarios such as FIFO execution, continuation, task sequencing, and turn execution order.

classes.name: MockSiloDetails
